import requests, re, time, os
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
t0=time.time(); B_="https://rest.uniprot.org"
OUT=os.getcwd(); print("writing artifacts to", OUT)
def search(q,f):
    o=[];u=f"{B_}/uniprotkb/search?query={requests.utils.quote(q)}&fields={f}&format=json&size=500"
    while u:
        r=requests.get(u,timeout=60);r.raise_for_status();o+=r.json()["results"]
        m=re.search(r'<([^>]+)>; rel="next"',r.headers.get("Link",""));u=m.group(1) if m else None
    return o
SUBS=[("P05067","APP","10656250"),("P51693","APLP1","14699155"),("Q06481","APLP2","14699155"),
("P46531","NOTCH1","10206645"),("Q04721","NOTCH2","18942891"),("Q9UM47","NOTCH3","12297501"),
("Q99466","NOTCH4","12297501"),("Q15303","ERBB4","11741961"),("P12830","CDH1","11850850"),
("P19022","CDH2","12612655"),("P16070","CD44","11964394"),("Q07954","LRP1","12198132"),
("P43146","DCC","12522141"),("O00548","DLL1","12794186"),("P78504","JAG1","12794186"),
("Q9Y219","JAG2","12794186"),("P29323","EPHB2","17428802"),("P54764","EPHA4","19303849"),
("P98172","EFNB1","16675544"),("P52799","EFNB2","16675544"),("Q02297","NRG1","12855954"),
("P07333","CSF1R","15123666"),("P14778","IL1R1","19864424"),("P27930","IL1R2","17565988"),
("P08138","NGFR","12730234"),("P14679","TYR","16567522"),("P16150","SPN","15590649"),
("Q13740","ALCAM","16777850"),("P13591","NCAM1","16837572"),("P15529","CD46","16920949"),
("P78423","CX3CL1","17158881"),("Q9H2A7","CXCL16","17158881"),("Q14114","LRP8","12881528"),
("P98155","VLDLR","15615712"),("Q15223","NECTIN1","12140560"),("O00533","CHL1","15215307"),
("P32004","L1CAM","15863509"),("P10912","GHR","15677469"),("P48551","IFNAR2","15123670"),
("P08887","IL6R","20410504"),("O60939","SCN2B","16014633"),("Q9UEF7","KL","19587256"),
("P16422","EPCAM","19854130"),("Q92673","SORL1","16815844"),("O75129","CLSTN1","15274632"),
("Q14126","DSG2","17724342"),("P19438","TNFRSF1A","18942891"),("O75509","TNFRSF21","18942891"),
("Q9NZC2","TREM2","23685555"),("P17948","FLT1","21807940"),("O75581","LRP6","18948252"),
("Q9Y5Y7","LYVE1","18942891")]
REF=pd.DataFrame(SUBS,columns=["acc","gene_curated","primary_pmid_lead"])
F="accession,gene_primary,sequence,ft_transmem,ft_signal,lit_pubmed_id"
BG=search('(organism_id:9606) AND (reviewed:true) AND (cc_scl_term:SL-9905)',F)
SU=requests.get(f"{B_}/uniprotkb/search",params={"query":" OR ".join(f"accession:{a}" for a,_,_ in SUBS),
   "fields":F,"format":"json","size":500},timeout=60).json()["results"]
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,
    'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
def ft(e):
    s_=e["sequence"]["value"];tms=[x for x in e.get("features",[]) if x["type"]=="Transmembrane"]
    if len(tms)!=1: return None
    a=tms[0]["location"]["start"]["value"];b=tms[0]["location"]["end"]["value"]
    if not a or not b: return None
    sg=[x for x in e.get("features",[]) if x["type"]=="Signal"]
    se=(sg[0]["location"]["end"]["value"] or 0) if sg else 0
    tm=s_[a-1:b];jx=s_[max(0,a-11):a-1];jc=s_[b:b+10]
    fr=lambda q,s:(sum(q.count(c) for c in s)/len(q) if q else np.nan);g=e.get("genes") or [{}]
    return dict(acc=e["primaryAccession"],gene=(g[0].get("geneName") or {}).get("value"),
      tm_seq=tm,ecto_len=a-1-se,tm_len=b-a+1,cyto_len=len(s_)-b,tm_GP=fr(tm,"GP"),
      tm_destab=fr(tm,"GPSTAND"),tm_gravy=float(np.mean([KD.get(c,0) for c in tm])),
      tm_beta=fr(tm,"IVT"),jmex_acidic=fr(jx,"DE"),jmcy_basic=fr(jc,"KR"),
      n_sxxxs=len(re.findall(r'(?=[GAS]...[GAS])',tm)),n_refs=len(e.get("references",[])))
S=pd.DataFrame([x for x in map(ft,SU) if x]).assign(label=1)
Bg=pd.DataFrame([x for x in map(ft,BG) if x]).assign(label=0); Bg=Bg[~Bg.acc.isin(set(S.acc))]
D=pd.concat([S,Bg],ignore_index=True).dropna().reset_index(drop=True)
y=D.label.values; refs=D.n_refs.values; bgidx=D.index[y==0].to_numpy(); nsub=int(y.sum())
FE=["ecto_len","tm_len","tm_GP","tm_destab","tm_gravy","tm_beta","cyto_len","jmex_acidic","jmcy_basic","n_sxxxs"]
LAB={"ecto_len":"Ectodomain length (full-length)","tm_len":"TM helix length",
 "tm_GP":"TM Gly+Pro fraction","tm_destab":"TM helix-destabilising fraction (GPSTAND)",
 "tm_gravy":"TM hydrophobicity (GRAVY)","tm_beta":"TM beta-branched fraction",
 "cyto_len":"Cytoplasmic tail length","jmex_acidic":"Extracellular JM acidic fraction",
 "jmcy_basic":"Cytoplasmic JM Lys+Arg fraction","n_sxxxs":"TM small-x-x-x-small motif count"}
# study-intensity-matched null, per feature (1000 resamples, rank AUC only)
edges=np.unique(np.quantile(refs[bgidx],np.linspace(0,1,11)))[1:-1]
sb=np.digitize(refs[y==1],edges); bb=np.digitize(refs[bgidx],edges)
pools={b:bgidx[bb==b] for b in np.unique(bb)}
rng=np.random.default_rng(3); NS=1000; labsets=[]
for _ in range(NS):
    pick=set()
    for b in sb:
        pl=pools.get(b,bgidx); c=rng.choice(pl)
        while c in pick: c=rng.choice(pl)
        pick.add(c)
    l=np.zeros(len(D),int); l[list(pick)]=1; labsets.append(l)
rows=[]
for c in FE:
    v=D[c].values; o=roc_auc_score(y,v)
    nul=np.array([roc_auc_score(l,v) for l in labsets])
    u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(D.loc[y==1,c],D.loc[y==0,c],alternative="two-sided")
    rows.append(dict(feature=c,label=LAB[c],sub_median=np.median(D.loc[y==1,c]),
      bg_median=np.median(D.loc[y==0,c]),observed_AUC=o,cliffs_delta=2*o-1,raw_p=p,
      matched_null_lo=np.percentile(nul,2.5),matched_null_hi=np.percentile(nul,97.5),
      p_vs_matched_null=(np.sum(np.abs(nul-.5)>=abs(o-.5))+1)/(NS+1)))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows); R["raw_p_fdr"]=multipletests(R.raw_p,method="fdr_bh")[1]
R["beats_matched_null"]=R.p_vs_matched_null<0.05
R=R.sort_values("observed_AUC",key=lambda s:(s-.5).abs(),ascending=False)
auc_refs=roc_auc_score(y,refs)
print("\n=== Per-feature separation vs study-intensity-matched null (1000 resamples) ===")
print(R[["label","sub_median","bg_median","observed_AUC","matched_null_lo","matched_null_hi",
         "p_vs_matched_null","raw_p_fdr","beats_matched_null"]].to_string(index=False,float_format=lambda x:f"{x:.3f}"))
print(f"\nBenchmark, no biology: UniProt reference count AUC = {auc_refs:.3f}")
print(f"n_substrates={nsub}  n_unlabeled_background={len(D)-nsub}  ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)")

R.to_csv(f"{OUT}/TABLE_feature_statistics.csv",index=False)
D.merge(REF,on="acc",how="left").to_csv(f"{OUT}/TABLE_all_proteins_features.csv",index=False)
S.merge(REF,on="acc",how="left")[["acc","gene","primary_pmid_lead","ecto_len","tm_len","tm_seq",
    "tm_destab","cyto_len","jmcy_basic","n_refs"]].to_csv(f"{OUT}/TABLE_substrate_set_with_refs.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5,6))
yp=np.arange(len(R))[::-1]
cols=["#c0392b" if b else "#8c9bab" for b in R.beats_matched_null]
ax.barh(yp,R.observed_AUC-0.5,left=0.5,height=.5,color=cols)
for yy,r in zip(yp,R.itertuples()):
    ax.plot([r.matched_null_lo,r.matched_null_hi],[yy]*2,color="#1b4f72",lw=2.2,alpha=.9)
    ax.plot([r.matched_null_lo]*2,[yy-.22,yy+.22],color="#1b4f72",lw=2.2)
    ax.plot([r.matched_null_hi]*2,[yy-.22,yy+.22],color="#1b4f72",lw=2.2)
ax.axvline(.5,color="k",lw=1)
ax.axvline(auc_refs,color="#f39c12",lw=2,ls="--")
ax.text(auc_refs+.004,len(R)-0.6,f"reference count\n(no biology): {auc_refs:.2f}",color="#b9770e",fontsize=8.5,va="top")
ax.set_yticks(yp); ax.set_yticklabels(R.label,fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("AUC separating 51 reported substrates from 1,105 unlabeled human type I proteins\n"
              "(blue bars = 95% range of the study-intensity-matched null)")
ax.set_xlim(0.40,0.86)
ax.set_title("No proposed determinant of gamma-secretase substrate scope separates substrates usefully.\n"
  "The helix-destabilisation features sit inside the null; how often a protein has been studied beats all of them.",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nfiles:", [f for f in os.listdir(OUT) if f.startswith("TABLE")])
